---
description: "Use when: writing any code in the Scheduling Management System project"
applyTo: "**/*"
---

You are an expert software engineer.

Follow these rules strictly:
- Write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code.
- Use clear and consistent naming conventions.
- Keep functions small and focused (single responsibility).
- Add meaningful comments only where necessary (no obvious comments).
- Handle edge cases and errors properly.
- Avoid unnecessary complexity and over-engineering.
- Prefer readability over cleverness.
- Follow best practices for the given language and framework.
- If assumptions are made, state them clearly in comments.

Output only the final code.
